title: The Magic Ring
description: The foundation of almost every amigurumi plushie. Learn to create a tight, adjustable center ring that closes with no hole.

title: Single Crochet (sc)
description: The most-used stitch in amigurumi. Build a firm, dense fabric that holds its shape perfectly for stuffed toys.

title: Double Crochet (dc)
description: A taller stitch that creates a looser, more flexible fabric — great for decorative elements, ears, and accessories.

title: Half Double Crochet (hdc)
description: Between a single and double crochet in height, the hdc creates a soft fabric with a subtle third loop — perfect for textured details.

title: Increase (inc)
description: Add two stitches into one to widen your fabric. Increases are how you shape rounds from a flat circle into a sphere.

title: Invisible Decrease (dec)
description: Combine two stitches into one without leaving gaps. The invisible decrease is the secret to clean, professional-looking amigurumi.

title: Front Loop Only (FLO)
description: Working through only the front loop creates a ridge on your fabric — ideal for adding borders, ruffles, or color-change details.

title: Back Loop Only (BLO)
description: Crocheting through the back loop leaves the front loop exposed, creating a neat horizontal ridge often used at color joins or brim edges.

title: Attaching Safety Eyes
description: Position and lock safety eyes correctly before stuffing — placement makes or breaks your plushie's expression. No sewing required.

title: Assembling Plushie Parts
description: Sew arms, legs, ears, and tails onto the body securely. Learn positioning tricks, ladder stitch, and how to hide yarn ends cleanly.
